card.name: Small words before assessment timepoints
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as on, at, each, or a hyphen that come right before a measure, visit, or follow-up time in clinical trial results. They set up how or when something was assessed.

modes.label: Before a timepoint
modes.description: The words at or on lead into a visit, month, or follow-up time.
modes.example: (defined as a decrease in severity by one or more grades from the worst grade)<< at>> last follow up.

modes.label: Before an assessment scale or visit
modes.description: A linking word or hyphen leads into a rating scale, a baseline result, or each visit.
modes.example: were specifically asked at<< each>> visit about the occurrence of these symptoms.
